## INTRAVASCULAR CATHETER-ASSOCIATED STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS INFECTION
Catheter removal is required. Obtain follow up blood cultures to document that
bacteremia clears on therapy.
Refer to cardiovascular section for suspected infectious endocarditis.
[Approach to Endocarditis](orzid2-gmenu-abx-appro-to-endocarditis)
## Consult infectious Diseases in all cases.
## Duration of therapy
## Inpatient

For uncomplicated infection, treat for 14 days. Longer duration is required for
complicated cases.
Refer to [Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia](orzid2-gmenu-bacteremia-s-aureus) recommendations for antimicrobial
selection
